gate_runs.detail: Audited the 3 most security-critical epic invariants — parseStructured strict guard (87.9%, epic guard behavioral mutants all killed; survivors=equivalent optional-chaining + pre-existing loose branches), messageActionUi suppression+admin-carveout (98.5%, lone survivor a pre-existing unrelated timestamp tiebreak), chatPersistence appendMessage materializedFromEdit supersession (core fix L374 mutants killed; survivors=dev-only e2e hooks + slice-equivalent + append-queue plumbing). No survivors on any audited epic behavioral invariant. Remaining order-sensitive modules (welcomeSubscription mark-seen, messageEdits/api announcement gate, cancelInvitationImpl, profileHandler, pendingInvitations) DEFERRED under compute bound — full Stryker across these MLS modules is hours each; compensating assurance: the adversarial per-story reviews already caught+fixed the 3 real order-sensitive/storage defects in exactly these modules (S3 TOCTOU, S6 mark-seen conflation, S8 immutability bypass) with regression tests, S9 property proofs exercise their whole-flow behavior, examiners verified per-AC non-vacuousness. DISCLOSED, not silently skipped.

Epic's own e2e spec groups-invite-lifecycle-announcements.spec.ts: 8/8 passed on a freshly-wiped relay (docker compose down -v && up -d --wait), 31.8s. Covers AC-PROD-1 (invited), AC-PROD-3 (accepted live at A), AC-DECLINE-3/9/10 (declined + C evicted), AC-IMMUT-1 (non-admin no edit/delete), AC-IMMUT-3 (admin moderation Delete no Edit) + bonus functional admin peer-delete. The project's definitive gate is the full 60-test suite (make test-e2e-all), chronically red on this host from rotating VM-latency timeouts unrelated to the epic (per project memory: judge by the epic's own specs, which pass) — recommended as the final CI/user sign-off.

Stage-1 Opus (resumable, whole-assembly) clean close-out, zero open findings across S1-S10 (caught+fixed 3 real defects during the run: S3 TOCTOU, S6 mark-seen conflation, S8 immutability bypass). Stage-2 cross-vendor Codex UNAVAILABLE (sandbox infra failure, 2 retries dead) — substituted with a Fable-model cross-model review (user-directed). Fable cleared privacy/forged-decline/double-Remove/immutability/parse-guard and found 3 real issues: (1) sev-4 materializedFromEdit supersession over-broadened → ordinary edit reverts/tombstone resurrects on late original arrival — FIXED (gate supersession on arrival being an announcement); (2) sev-2 empty-groupId wasted decline send — FIXED (send gate + groupId); (3) sev-3 multi-device decline-vs-join race — DOCUMENTED as accepted Known Limitation. Fable re-review after remediation: CLEAN, 0 findings.
